  \cventry
    {\href{https://github.com/openscilab/memor}{Memor}: conversational memory across LLMs}{2025}
    {Lead developer, OpenSciLab. Manages the memory of a user's interactions with LLMs: past conversations can be tapped when prompting, and parts of an exchange with one model carried over to another, bridging otherwise isolated LLM instances.\projectstats{67 stars, 4 forks, 960 downloads/month}}

  \cventry
    {\href{https://github.com/openscilab/tocount}{ToCount}: lightweight token estimator}{2025}
    {Developer, OpenSciLab. Estimates token counts for LLM input using rule-based and ML methods, for prompt analysis and token budgeting. The design point is the cost of the answer: an exact count means loading a whole tokenizer.\projectstats{23 stars, 2 forks, 32 downloads/month}}

  \cventry
    {\href{https://github.com/openscilab/xnum}{XNum}: universal numeral system converter}{2025}
    {Developer, OpenSciLab. Converts digits across English, Persian, Hindi, Arabic-Indic, Bengali, and other numeral systems, auto-detecting mixed formats and converting only the numbers while leaving surrounding text untouched.\projectstats{35 stars, 1 fork, 50 downloads/month}}

  \cventry
    {\href{https://github.com/openscilab/ipspot}{IPSpot}: system IP address fetcher}{2025}
    {Developer, OpenSciLab. Reports both the private address a machine holds on its own network and the public address the internet sees it from, over IPv4 and IPv6.\projectstats{104 stars, 6 forks, 97 downloads/month}}

  \cventry
    {\href{https://github.com/openscilab/drux}{Drux}: drug release analysis framework}{2025}

  \cventry
    {\href{https://github.com/openscilab/pymilo}{PyMilo}: Python library for ML I/O}{2024}
    {Co-developer, OpenSciLab. A flexible I/O interface for ML pipelines that serializes models into a transparent, non-executable format, so a model can be read before it is loaded rather than run on trust.\projectstats{169 stars, 7 forks, 73 downloads/month}}

  \cventry
    {\href{https://github.com/openscilab/opr}{OPR}: optimized primer design tool}{2024}
